description.en: A short-headed bipedal reconstruction with featherlike body covering and a distinctly scaly long tail. It combines partial fossils; featherlike structures follow the original authors' interpretation, while density, colour, muscles and pose are inferred.
description.zh: 短头双足复原，具有羽状体被和明显覆鳞的长尾。综合部分化石，羽状结构沿用原作者解释；密度、颜色、肌肉与姿态为推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole short-headed biped with featherlike body covering and distinctly scaly long tail, short forelimbs and elongated hindlimbs.

scientific_limits.en: Primary description combines six partial skulls and many disarticulated skeletons; Fig1 whole skeleton is composite, not one complete fossil. Holotype skull INREC K3/109, other body/integument specimens separately identified.1.5m is approximate descriptive body length, not complete fossil measurement. Featherlike structures interpretation follows original authors; evolutionary homology debated. Density, colour, muscles and pose inferred; tail scales are thin epidermal structures, not osteoderms.
scientific_limits.zh: 原描述综合六件部分头骨及许多散离骨架，图1为合成复原非单件完整化石。正模头骨K3/109与其他体被标本分开。1.5米为概述体长估值，非完整标本实测。羽状结构解释依原作者，演化同源性仍有争论；密度、颜色、肌肉姿势推定。尾鳞薄而属表皮，不做骨甲。

scale.basis: Godefroit etal2014 descriptive approximate body length, composite anatomy not exact individual measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Compact short skull and beaked herbivorous muzzle, short forelimbs, long hindlimbs and long tapering tail.
Fine short filament/featherlike tufts around head, neck and torso and proximal limbs; no flight-wing vanes.
Tail largely smooth-looking at distance but with readable rows of thin overlapping scales, not fluffy feather tail or thick armour.
Keep featherlike torso versus scaly-tail regional contrast clear in standard side/perspective views.
Neutral biped stance, palms inward; do not use large carnivorous teeth or raptor sickle claws.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed Fig1 composite skeleton and true holotype skull INREC K3/109; Fig2 tail scale K4/94 and K4/117 photos, head filaments K4/22 and thorax K4/33.

reference_credits.title: Godefroit etal2014 A Jurassic ornithischian dinosaur from Siberia with both feathers and scales
